flags: The cache supports the scenic highway’s advertised character, but not the catalog’s National Forest Scenic Byway designation or 1989 date. Omitted those specifics. Road builders and construction history are not documented; the history paragraph uses the supported corridor history.

Visit Montana gives approximately 49 miles; material maps 43.8 miles. Omitted total mileage. It calls the southern terminus County Highway 278 while material calls it MT 278; used Highway 278 without a jurisdiction label.

Coolidge and Elkhorn Hot Springs are retained with short texts because the cache provides little site history. The springs moment treats the natural feature and seasonal road boundary, without promoting a lodging business or claiming historic-landmark status.

Coolidge is not in the strip towns and lacks a coordinate-bearing cache article. Its ordering before Elkhorn follows the existing sequence; exact excursion position needs map verification. No coordinates invented.

No inherited claim was wholly unsupported. Omitted the reputed oldest lodgepole grove because the cache supplies no locatable stand or underlying age research. Changed anyone may dig for crystals to omission because a public-digging statement does not establish current rules.
Closure note checked against the supplied cache only, dated 2026-10-11 as required; no live access confirmation was available.
